turns.question: By what percentage was revenue on Thursday 24 September 2026 up on the same weekday a week earlier?
turns.answer: Revenue on Thursday 24 September 2026 was 542.00 EUR, up 21.1 % (revenue week-over-week growth 0.2112) on Thursday 17 September 2026's 447.50 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
